name: RF Spectrum Analysis
description: Ability to perform comprehensive RF spectrum analysis using spectrum analyzers and SDR platforms. Covers spectrum survey methodology, signal identification and classification, measurement of signal parameters (power, bandwidth, occupied bandwidth, spurious emissions), spectrum occupancy analysis, and characterization of the RF environment in target facilities.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to RF spectrum analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands spectrum analysis concepts and the RF measurement environment
evidence: Can explain spectrum analyzer operation (RBW, VBW, sweep time, detector types)
Understands dBm, dBc, and signal-to-noise ratio measurement fundamentals
Completed training on RF spectrum analysis methodology

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs spectrum measurements and signal identification under supervision
evidence: Configured spectrum analyzer parameters for signal measurement tasks under guidance
Identified common signal types (WiFi, Bluetooth, cellular, ISM-band devices) from spectral signatures
Performed basic signal power and bandwidth measurements under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts spectrum surveys and characterizes the RF environment
evidence: Independently conducted spectrum surveys for 3+ facilities or frequency ranges
Classified and documented all observed signals with frequency, bandwidth, power, and modulation type
Identified anomalous or unauthorized emissions in surveyed environments
Produced spectrum survey reports with calibrated measurements and signal inventories

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced spectrum analysis; develops survey automation; handles challenging RF environments
evidence: Conducted spectrum analysis in high-density RF environments with hundreds of concurrent signals
Developed automated spectrum monitoring and anomaly detection systems
Performed calibrated power measurements with documented measurement uncertainty
Mentors junior analysts on spectrum analysis methodology and measurement technique

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab spectrum analysis methodology; designs measurement systems; recognized RF measurement authority
evidence: Authored the lab's spectrum analysis methodology and measurement procedures
Designed custom spectrum monitoring and measurement systems for the lab
Published research on RF spectrum analysis or monitoring techniques
Trains teams on spectrum analysis and maintains lab measurement traceability

assessment_methods.description: Conduct a spectrum survey of a lab environment across a specified frequency range, identifying and documenting all observed signals with calibrated measurements
Observe spectrum analyzer configuration, measurement technique, and signal identification during a survey

equipment: Keysight N9040B or equivalent real-time spectrum analyzer
Calibrated broadband antenna set (biconical, log-periodic, horn)
